card.title: How To Repair iPhone 13 to 16 pro max Proximity sensor not working

source.title: How To Repair iPhone 13 to 16 pro max Proximity sensor not working

claims.statement: On iPhone 13–16, a liquid-damaged or non-programmed replacement proximity/ambient light flex removes proximity and auto-brightness (the toggle disappears).
Fix: JC Repair Assistant Brushing unbind with IPSW flash, then test and 'Activate FPC' on a JCID photosensitive sensor so its ECID matches, then install.

procedure: Confirm proximity failure and missing auto-brightness toggle.
Download the IPSW; run Brushing with both unbind options.
Reflash in 3uTools when it lands in recovery.
Test and Activate the JCID sensor; confirm ECID match.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: The unbind flash erases the device.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
